description: attempts to load one or more user-defined plot item DLLs. If successful, these plot items will be available in the GUI for plotting.

keywords.name: automatic
keywords.description: Automatically attempt to load all compatible plot-item DLLs found in the plugins directory.

keywords.name: dll
keywords.description: Attempt to load the plot-item DLL named s; if not a fully qualified path the plugins directories are searched.

notes: The DLL name must be a quoted string; a bare token is rejected.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on the PFC3D 6.00 and 9.8 GUIs (syntax grade): 'plot load automatic' accepted on both GUIs; a bare (unquoted) DLL name rejected.
